run_interop_matrix_tests: run gRPC interop tests across languages and releases using docker images from GCR
get_test_images_for_lang: get docker images for a language across releases and runtimes keyed by runtime
read_test_cases_file: read test cases from a bash-like testcase file and return a list of commands
generate_test_case_jobspecs: generate JobSpec objects from testcase file lines for a given language and release
pull_image_for_lang: pull a docker image for a given language from the image registry
test_release: run all test cases for a specific language runtime and release combination
run_tests_for_lang: find and run all test cases for a language across multiple releases with batched pulls
cleanup_docker_image: remove a docker image from the local system after tests complete
